description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Ra, which wraps and extends SVN::Ra for use by git-svn. It includes methods for SVN operations, caching, compatibility handling across SVN versions, and specific functions for git-svn integration.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: A Perl class that extends SVN::Ra to add caching, compatibility, and git-svn specific functions.

methods.name: _auth_providers
methods.description: Defines and returns a list of SVN authentication providers.

methods.name: prepare_config_once
methods.description: Initializes SVN configuration and authentication parameters once.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN::Ra object, ensuring URL canonicalization and caching.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks if a path exists in the repository with caching.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory entries with caching and SVN version compatibility.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Retrieves commit logs with adjustments for SVN version limitations.

methods.name: trees_match
methods.description: Checks if two SVN trees match, for older SVN versions.

methods.name: get_commit_editor
methods.description: Gets a commit editor, with SVN version considerations.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Performs an SVN update operation with path handling.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Performs an SVN switch operation, handling URL reparenting.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Finds the longest common path among a set of GitSVN objects and globs.

methods.name: gs_fetch_loop_common
methods.description: Fetches SVN logs in a loop, handling revisions and commits for git-svn.

methods.name: get_dir_globbed
methods.description: Recursively retrieves directory entries with globbing.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Reduces the URL to its minimal form relative to the repository root.

methods.name: can_do_switch
methods.description: Checks if SVN switch is supported.

methods.name: skip_unknown_revs
methods.description: Handles specific SVN errors by ignoring certain error codes.
